svg.title: 04 | The full cell distribution keeps trade support visible
svg.desc: TF001R2 · same 88 original cells · 2020–2023 spent Discovery · 25 positive / 63 negative Histogram: fixed 0.05R bins, one observation per native cell. Scatter: all 88 means paired with their own completed-trade count. Cells share instruments and dates and are correlated; 88 cells are not 88 independent tests. Counts sum to 152,753 overlapping trade records. Arithmetic price-R means retain original tails and zero-R telemetry. Support is descriptive, not a confidence interval or net-profit qualification. Source B22.
